effect_description_eng:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing the top card of your security stack, change the original DP of 1 Digimon to 6000 until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
